steps.content: By the time Bureau personnel arrive to scatter the crowd and escort you back to your office, half an hour has already elapsed.
Only now do you finally find out what has happened.
[Television]

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Yes, during the Viers Mansion attack, the MBCC Chief and I worked together to organize rescue efforts and quell the unrest. I can't disclose the specifics, but yes, I'm referring to the legendary Chief ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I've been tracking his endeavors for a long time. Our perspectives align remarkably on matters concerning Mania, FAC, and issues within the West District. This incident has forged a profound bond between us, as we both aspire to change this city!
steps.female_content: I've been tracking her endeavors for a long time. Our perspectives align remarkably on matters concerning Mania, FAC, and issues within the West District. This incident has forged a profound bond between us, as we both aspire to change this city!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: What? ${PlayerName} stated he wouldn't interfere with the election right from the start? Oh sure, sure, let's just roll with that. But remember—actions speak louder than words. And more importantly, what do WE think when we look at him?
steps.female_content: What? ${PlayerName} stated she wouldn't interfere with the election right from the start? Oh sure, sure, let's just roll with that. But remember—actions speak louder than words. And more importantly, what do WE think when we look at her?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Look at him, look at all those who are fighting like him. Our city may have lost its way, reality may have left you disappointed, but as long as we have people like them, we can still believe in change for our city.
steps.female_content: Look at her, look at all those who are fighting like her. Our city may have lost its way, reality may have left you disappointed, but as long as we have people like them, we can still believe in change for our city.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: My friends, ask your hearts—if they still yearn for something better, then step out of your homes and make your votes count! This is our chance to seize our destiny. If we wish to change our city, let it start with ourselves!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Staying passive won't pave the way to a brighter tomorrow. We must take part in shaping our own future. Believe, take action, and cast your vote for me! I am Ma—
[Sound of TV being turned off]
...So, he's been using you for publicity. It seems that you truly can't place trust in anyone running for election.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: WHO ON EARTH is voting for him?!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I'm soooo mad! It's all Chief's doing, but he's taking all the credit and even rubbing it in our faces! And then he's even got the nerve to send you that message, saying he's going to visit you! Ugh! What a politician—so shameless! All this for votes!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief, don't meet with him! You're too soft-hearted, and you're too easily fooled by people like that!
While Wynn keeps chattering away, your thoughts drift entirely elsewhere.
Your association with the mansion incident has been exposed, and there's no telling what complications this might further cause. You must find the real culprit, fast.
Right now, you desperately need leads, intel—anything at all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Has Jelena provided any new information?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Umm... no, nothing new after that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then arrange another meeting. I'll ask her myself.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief... You've already done enough for today. I think it's best if you take a break now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No need for that. There's still a lot on the agenda, and time is running short...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hold on... What's that?
On one of the monitor screens, you catch a glimpse of an unexpected figure.
